name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Hardware-Accelerated 60/120 FPS Fluid Engine: Reduced heavy blurs and enabled CSS layout containment for buttery-smooth scrolling across Link Downloader and Search Studio.
Snappy Instant View Switching: Fast GPU-composited section transitions completely eliminating view-switching lag.
Global Atmospheric Fluid Mesh: Moving multi-chromatic ambient mesh drifting gracefully across the background.
Living Card & Footer Gradients: Animated abstract gradient flow inside cards and footers, with moving chromatic shimmer rims.
Fixed AMOLED Theme Selector: Restored glassmorphism and gradient animations for all dark mode users while preserving pure black for Solid AMOLED style.
